title: Bijective stage quotient comparisons induce a bijective colimit quotient map
statement: Let D be a category and F,G:D → CommRing be diagrams having colimits B,C [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let A be a commutative ring, K an ideal, b:const A → F a natural transformation, and bB:A → B a ring map such that b_j followed by the j-th colimit coprojection is bB for every j. Let η:F → G be a natural transformation and let u:B → C be its induced colimit map. If the induced quotient map F_j/(K.map b_j) → G_j/((K.map b_j).map η_j) is bijective for every j, then B/(K.map bB) → C/((K.map bB).map u) is bijective. No filteredness or finite-generation assumption is required.

source.place: XX 4.4, printed pp.373–374, passage to colimits of congruences; universal-property elaboration of the original completion-density proof step 6.

proof.text: Write L_j=K F_j and M_j=L_j G_j. Invert each specified stage quotient map. Compose its inverse with the quotient of the source coprojection to obtain t_j:G_j→B/KB. It kills M_j and satisfies t_j η_j = q_B ι_j. The inverses are determined by the bijective maps, not chosen from arbitrary existence.

For a transition j→k, both maps G_j→B/KB given by t_j and t_k G(j→k) kill M_j. Since F_j→G_j/M_j is surjective, equality is detected after composition with η_j. Naturality of η and of the source coprojections gives this equality. Thus the t_j form a cocone. Descend it to v:C→B/KB using the colimit universal property; coprojection extensionality gives vu=q_B.

The equality vu=q_B shows that v kills the image of KB in C, so v factors to C/KC→B/KB. The left inverse identity follows on source quotient representatives. For the right inverse identity, test on each target coprojection. Both maps kill M_j, and their equality after η_j follows from vu=q_B and colimit naturality. Surjectivity F_j→G_j/M_j gives equality; colimit extensionality and quotient extensionality finish. The proof covers an empty D, zero rings and K=0 or K=A.

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_quotientMap_bijective
    {D : Type v} [Category.{w} D]
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (K : Ideal A)
    (F G : D ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F] [HasColimit G]
    (b : (Functor.const D).obj A ⟶ F)
    (bB : A ⟶ colimit F)
    (hb : ∀ j : D, b.app j ≫ colimit.ι F j = bB)
    (η : F ⟶ G)
    (hη : ∀ j, Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap ((K.map (b.app j).hom).map (η.app j).hom)
        (η.app j).hom Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap ((K.map bB.hom).map (colimMap η).hom)
        (colimMap η).hom Ideal.le_comap_map)
